name: The Crown of Will
summary: Melisara sends the Crown of Will to the Undercity, where Sharlindra will see it reaches Lady Sylvanas.

sections.title: To the Undercity
sections.body: Melisara sends you with the Crown to Sharlindra in the Undercity. Sharlindra will pass it on to Lady Sylvanas. Melisara warns you not to use the Crown for your own ends. Mug'Thol's fate is warning enough.

sections.title: Sharlindra's Reaction
sections.body: Sharlindra recognizes the Crown as the relic the ogre used to escape the Dark Lady's will. She finds it odd that so plain an object held such power and fell into such clumsy hands. Sharlindra will take it from the Undercity to Lady Sylvanas and tell her what you did.

faq.q: Who receives the Crown of Will in the Undercity?
aliases: where do i take the crown
faq.answer: Sharlindra receives the Crown in the Undercity. Melisara says Sharlindra will pass it on to Lady Sylvanas.

faq.q: Why does Melisara warn against using the crown?
aliases: why not use crown of will
faq.answer: Because of Mug'Thol's fate, which Melisara holds up as warning enough against using the Crown for your own ends.

faq.q: Who sends you with the crown?
faq.answer: Melisara sends you with the Crown as the fifth and final part, after the fourth.
